missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Navigate to the login page URL. Wait for the page to load completely and verify that key login page elements (username field, password field, login button) are visible.
Locate the username input field, clear any existing text, and input the provided username parameter. Verify the text was entered successfully.
Locate the login button element, wait for it to be clickable, and perform a click action. Wait for any loading indicators to disappear after clicking.
